digest.component_or_area: CLI guide discovery and packaged author guides
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a rebar checkout encounter dead links in CLI-served guides due to internal cross-references using consumer-relative paths (review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md, etc.)

The commit-trailer format specification (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home and is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help, leaving repo-less clients with no way to discover it
Packaged author guides must repoint all dangling references to either rebar explain <topic> for sibling guides or https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/… for repo-only docs
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered as a topic in AUTHOR_GUIDES registry and served by rebar explain commit-trailer, matching the pattern used for plan and review guides
A guard test must prevent regression by asserting that all markdown links in packaged guides resolve only via https://, http://, #anchors, or mailto:, never consumer-relative paths
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring and packaging tests must be updated to include the new commit-trailer guide so repo-less clients can discover it
